title: Oracle changes in one transaction share their SCN
symptom: Silver kept an inserted row's first image after an update of it in the same transaction
cause: Debezium's Oracle connector (LogMiner, 3.7.0.Final) gives every change of a transaction the same source.scn; silver ordered a key's changes by scn alone, a tie
effect: An insert and an update of one key committed together can land in silver as the insert
fix: Order Oracle's events by the SCN, then the redo record's address source.rs_id (fixed-width hex, as text): the scn_rs kind
